item.text: [{"task_id":"8fbca751","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    foreground = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    background = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    fill = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    band_height = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    result = grid.copy()","    points = np.argwhere(grid == foreground)","    if len(points) == 0 or band_height <= 0:","        return result","    first_row = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    last_row = int(np.max(points[:, 0]))","    for start in range(first_row, last_row + 1, band_height):","        selected = points[(points[:, 0] >= start) & (points[:, 0] < start + band_height)]","        if len(selected) == 0:","            continue","        top = int(np.min(selected[:, 0]))","        bottom = int(np.max(selected[:, 0]))","        left = int(np.min(selected[:, 1]))","        right = int(np.max(selected[:, 1]))","        for row in range(top, bottom + 1):","            for col in range(left, right + 1):","                if grid[row, col] == background:","                    result[row, col] = fill","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"geometry":[1]},"params":{"colors":[8,0,2],"geometry":[4]},"rationale":"The shapes occupy four-row bands anchored at the first foreground row.
